title: Invoked GRAP stage (rules-as-data)
description: Which stage a CAQM ORDER has invoked, together with the verbatim sentence that invoked it. This is NOT computed from an AQI reading: an order can invoke a stage pre-emptively on a forecast, or decline to. The implied stage is derived separately from stage_bands. When the two disagree, Aadesh says so rather than choosing. The citation is mandatory because this single field decides whether any obligation in the corpus applies at all. A stage may also be REVOKED by a later order; a revoked invocation carries its own revocation citation and is treated as historical/replay evidence, never as currently in force.

stage.description: Stage ordinal as stated in the order. No maximum is encoded: which stages exist is declared by the corpus, not by this schema or by application code. The quoted sentence must itself name this stage; editing the ordinal without changing the sentence is exactly what verification catches.

lifecycle.description: Whether this invocation is currently in force (active) or was revoked by a later order (revoked). A revoked invocation is retained as historical/replay evidence and is never handed to the resolver as the live stage. Absent is treated as active so existing records keep their meaning.

source_doc.description: doc_id of the order in sources/manifest.json. The same key every other citation uses, so verification can find it without a special case.

quote.description: VERBATIM text from that page stating the stage is invoked. `make verify` re-checks it like any other citation, and additionally requires it to name the stage it invokes.

invoked_at.description: ISO-8601 instant the order took effect, as stated in the order, not as observed by a clock. The orders in this corpus take effect 'with immediate effect' on their issue date, so this is the effective-from instant.

revocation.description: Required when lifecycle is 'revoked'. The later order that revoked this invocation, cited the same way the invocation itself is.

quote.description: VERBATIM text from that page stating the revocation. `make verify` re-checks it like any other citation.

revoked_at.description: ISO-8601 instant the revocation took effect, as stated in the revoking order.

note.description: Optional editorial note. Never the legal basis for anything; the quote is.
